methodological_rigor.justification: Retrospective radiotherapy outcomes cohort study. Sample size and power calculation not apparent from excerpt. Treatment protocols and outcome assessment (response per imaging, survival per medical records) documented. Statistical analysis: log-rank tests for survival comparison, Cox regression for multivariate analysis. Potential confounders (radiation dose heterogeneity, prior treatments) not fully addressed.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Retrospective cohort study (LoE: 2b) identifying radiotherapy response biomarkers in specific cancer population. Clinically relevant if biomarkers enable treatment selection. Currently descriptive rather than actionable without prospective validation.

reporting_quality.justification: STROBE observational reporting; baseline characteristics, treatment protocols, endpoints documented. Gaps: inter-observer assessment reproducibility (for biomarker measurement), complete outcome follow-up rates not specified, data sharing statement absent.

novelty_literature.justification: Retrospective biomarker-outcome association study; incremental contribution without mechanistic insight or prospective validation.

writing_presentation.justification: Retrospective cohort report with standard organization. Methods and results presented but some clarity gaps regarding imaging protocol standardization.

key_strengths: Retrospective data on meaningful outcomes (local control, OS)
key_concerns: Retrospective design: selection bias, incomplete outcome ascertainment, missing data patterns not characterized
Biomarker validation: requires prospective external cohort confirmation
Methodological gaps: confounding variables, treatment heterogeneity not fully addressed
chief_reviewer.rationale: Tier 3 paper: retrospective biomarker-outcome study requiring major revisions addressing validation strategy and confounding.
